title: A Busy Journey to the Office

sentences.text_target: Tom wakes up early in the morning.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm weɪks ʌp ˈɜːli ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Tom se réveille tôt le matin.

sentences.text_target: He leaves his home quickly.
sentences.text_native: Il quitte sa maison rapidement.

sentences.text_target: He walks down the quiet street.
sentences.text_native: Il marche dans la rue calme.

sentences.text_target: He turns at the corner.
sentences.text_native: Il tourne au coin de la rue.

sentences.text_target: He sees the blue bus stop.
sentences.text_native: Il voit l'arrêt de bus bleu.

sentences.text_target: A lot of people wait there.
sentences.text_native: Beaucoup de gens attendent là.

sentences.text_target: Tom looks at his watch for the time.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm lʊks æt hɪz wɒtʃ fɔː ðə taɪm/
sentences.text_native: Tom regarde sa montre pour voir l'heure.

sentences.text_target: He waits for five minutes.
sentences.text_native: Il attend pendant cinq minutes.

sentences.text_target: The big bus arrives.
sentences.text_native: Le grand bus arrive.

sentences.text_target: The front door opens slowly.
sentences.text_native: La porte avant s'ouvre lentement.

sentences.text_target: Tom steps inside the vehicle.
sentences.text_native: Tom monte à l'intérieur du véhicule.

sentences.text_target: He speaks to the friendly driver.
sentences.text_native: Il parle au chauffeur sympathique.

sentences.text_target: He pays with his travel card.
sentences.text_native: Il paie avec sa carte de transport.

sentences.text_target: He takes a free seat.
sentences.text_native: Il prend une place libre.

sentences.text_target: The engine starts to make noise.
sentences.text_native: Le moteur commence à faire du bruit.

sentences.text_target: The transport enters the big city.
sentences.text_native: Le transport entre dans la grande ville.

sentences.text_target: Tom looks outside through the glass.
sentences.text_native: Tom regarde dehors à travers la vitre.

sentences.text_target: Small raindrops fall now.
sentences.text_native: De petites gouttes de pluie tombent maintenant.

sentences.text_target: Many red cars block the road.
sentences.text_native: De nombreuses voitures rouges bloquent la route.

sentences.text_target: The traffic moves very slowly.
sentences.text_native: La circulation avance très lentement.

sentences.text_target: The bus turns right at the light.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə bʌs tɜːnz raɪt æt ðə laɪt/
sentences.text_native: Le bus tourne à droite au feu.

sentences.text_target: Other passengers read a paper ticket.
sentences.text_native: D'autres passagers lisent un ticket en papier.

sentences.text_target: The vehicle stops near a large station.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈviːɪkl stɒps nɪə ə lɑːdʒ ˈsteɪʃən/
sentences.text_native: Le véhicule s'arrête près d'une grande gare.

sentences.text_target: Some people get off the bus.
sentences.text_native: Certaines personnes descendent du bus.

sentences.text_target: Tom stays on his comfortable seat.
sentences.text_native: Tom reste sur son siège confortable.

sentences.text_target: The journey continues for ten minutes.
sentences.text_native: Le trajet continue pendant dix minutes.

sentences.text_target: Finally, the bus reaches his stop.
sentences.text_native: Enfin, le bus arrive à son arrêt.

sentences.text_target: Tom stands up and says goodbye.
sentences.text_native: Tom se lève et dit au revoir.

sentences.text_target: He walks quickly to his office work.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɔːks ˈkwɪkli tuː hɪz ˈɒfɪs wɜːk/
sentences.text_native: Il marche rapidement vers son travail de bureau.

sentences.text_target: He arrives happy and ready.
sentences.text_native: Il arrive heureux et prêt.
